correctness.rationale: For each fixed nonzero rational parameter, the circle norm is partitioned into uniquely indexed exponential log-ratio windows. The zero branch yields the exact finite arithmetic-gaps contribution. Nonzero centers have transcendental exponential ratios, enabling a Weyl-equidistribution lattice-counting lemma with leading sN/(a exp(j/a)). The high-branch tail is absolutely controlled by a geometric series plus O(log N/N). Ordered-pair doubling, the case s=0, derivative jumps, and the equivalent closed form all follow rigorously. A separately implemented finite verifier corroborated 72 direct counts and 18 N=50000 profiles; finite experiments are not used as proof.
